headline: No single node holds the key.
subheadline: Five nodes. Any three reconstruct. Air-gap capable. No call home.
features:
5-node split key, any 3 reconstruct
A dropped node recovers without an operator in the loop
AES-256-GCM, tamper checks, stale shards rejected
Audit memory that survives a hard reset
Fully offline. No telemetry. No cloud dependency.
Python on your hardware, from a Pi to bare metal
